description: This file defines a template class 'List' used to maintain a list of supported IDs, implemented with std::vector, including methods for accessing, adding, and sizing the list.

classes.name: device::List
classes.description: A template class implementing a list of IDs with methods for access and modification.

methods.name: at(size_t i) const
methods.description: Returns a const reference to an instance of T corresponding to the ID at index i.

methods.name: at(size_t i)
methods.description: Returns a modifiable reference to an instance of T corresponding to the ID at index i.

methods.name: push_back(const T& x)
methods.description: Adds the ID of the given instance x to the list.

methods.name: size()
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.
